# NeoFidu

> NeoFidu is a Swiss online fiduciary (fiduciaire en ligne) serving French-speaking Switzerland. We provide tax return preparation, company incorporation, and accounting services for individuals and businesses across 6 cantons: Vaud (VD), Geneva (GE), Valais (VS), Fribourg (FR), Neuchatel (NE), and Jura (JU).

Key information:

- NeoFidu operates exclusively in French-speaking Switzerland (Suisse romande)
- Tax returns start from CHF 89 for a single person (supplements: couple +30, per child +15, per property +60, self-employed income +100, living abroad +60); standard processing in 14 business days, priority in 7 days (+120)
- Run by a certified Swiss fiduciary specialist with 10+ years of experience in French-speaking Swiss taxation
- Company creation from CHF 290 (sole proprietorship), CHF 990 (Sàrl/GmbH), CHF 1,490 (SA/AG); accounting from CHF 500/year (self-employed) or CHF 200/month (SMEs)
- All services are delivered online by a certified Swiss fiduciary specialist
- The site is primarily in French, with English versions of the tax return guides and municipality pages

## Services

- [Tax returns for individuals](https://neofidu.ch/particuliers): Personal tax return preparation with cantonal expertise (VD, GE, VS, FR, NE, JU)
- [Services for businesses](https://neofidu.ch/entreprises): Company creation, accounting, VAT registration, and corporate tax returns
- [Services for associations and foundations](https://neofidu.ch/associations-fondations): Specialized services for non-profit organizations
- [Pricing](https://neofidu.ch/tarifs): Transparent pricing for all services
- [Submit a request](https://neofidu.ch/demande): Online form to request a quote or service

## Data: tax barometer and municipalities

- [French-speaking Switzerland tax barometer 2026 (FR)](https://neofidu.ch/barometre-fiscal): 2026 income tax (federal, cantonal, municipal) in all 657 municipalities of Vaud, Geneva, Valais, Fribourg, Neuchâtel and Jura for 4 typical profiles, computed with the official Swiss Federal Tax Administration (FTA/AFC) calculator. Canton medians, 10 lowest and highest-taxed municipalities, main towns, full ranking
- [Tax barometer (EN)](https://neofidu.ch/en/barometre-fiscal): English version
- [Barometer data (CSV)](https://neofidu.ch/barometre-fiscal/donnees.csv): All figures, free to reuse with attribution
- [Municipality pages](https://neofidu.ch/communes): one page per municipality (657) with the municipal tax coefficient and 2026 income tax for 4 profiles (single CHF 60,000 and 100,000 gross; married couple with 2 children, CHF 150,000; retired couple, CHF 70,000 pensions). URL pattern: https://neofidu.ch/communes/<name>-<canton>, e.g. /communes/lausanne-vd. English: /en/communes/<slug>
- [Company Observatory](https://neofidu.ch/observatoire): Statistics on the 185,000+ companies registered in French-speaking Switzerland (legal forms, sectors, cantons)

## MCP server (AI connector)

- [NeoFidu MCP server](https://neofidu.ch/api/mcp): Remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP, no authentication, read-only). Tools: calculate_income_tax (2026 Swiss income tax, all cantons, official FTA calculator), get_municipality_taxes, rank_municipalities (657 French-speaking municipalities), search_tax_guides (VaudTax, GeTax, VSTax, FriTax guides). Setup instructions: https://neofidu.ch/en/connecteur-ia

## Free simulators

- [Income tax simulator](https://neofidu.ch/simulateur/impots): 2026 income tax for any Swiss canton and every French-speaking municipality, computed with the official FTA calculator (pillar 3a deduction included)
- [Tax map](https://neofidu.ch/simulateur/carte-impots): Interactive map comparing tax burden across Swiss cantons
- [Net salary simulator](https://neofidu.ch/simulateur/salaire-net): Gross-to-net salary with Swiss social contributions (AVS/AHV, AI, APG, AC, LPP)
- [Pillar 3a simulator](https://neofidu.ch/simulateur/3eme-pilier): Tax savings from pillar 3a contributions
- [Imputed rental value simulator](https://neofidu.ch/simulateur/valeur-locative): Valeur locative and the 2026 reform
- [Real estate capital gains tax simulator](https://neofidu.ch/simulateur/gain-immobilier): Impôt sur les gains immobiliers by canton and holding period
- [Rent reduction calculator](https://neofidu.ch/simulateur/baisse-loyer): Rent reduction after a fall in the reference mortgage rate
- [Retirement income simulator](https://neofidu.ch/simulateur/retraite): AVS, LPP and pillar 3a retirement income
- [Swiss debt counter](https://neofidu.ch/dette-suisse): Swiss public debt in real time

## Tax return guides (step by step)

- [Tax deductions guide](https://neofidu.ch/guide/deductions-fiscales): All 2026 tax deductions compared across the 6 French-speaking cantons (EN: /en/guide/deductions-fiscales)
- [VaudTax guide (FR)](https://neofidu.ch/guide/vaudtax): How to fill in the Vaud tax return in VaudTax, section by section, with official 2026 Vaud deduction amounts and return codes
- [VaudTax guide (EN)](https://neofidu.ch/en/guide/vaudtax): English version for expats, quoting the French VaudTax labels
- Chapters: before you start, personal situation and children, salary, work expenses, insurance and pillar 3a, accounts/securities/crypto, wealth and debts, housing, family deductions, training/medical/donations, checking and filing, source tax/TOU/quasi-residents/French cross-border workers (https://neofidu.ch/guide/vaudtax/<chapter>)
- [GeTax guide (FR)](https://neofidu.ch/guide/getax): How to fill in the Geneva tax return in GeTax (desktop or online), screen by screen, with official 2026 Geneva deduction amounts and return codes (11.10, 31.50, 52.21, etc.)
- [GeTax guide (EN)](https://neofidu.ch/en/guide/getax): English version for expats and cross-border workers, quoting the French GeTax labels with translations
- Chapters: before you start, personal situation and children, salary, work expenses, pension savings (pillar 3a, 3a catch-up, buy-ins), accounts/securities/crypto, wealth and debts, property, deductions, source tax/TOU/quasi-residents/cross-border workers, checking and filing (https://neofidu.ch/guide/getax/<chapter>)
- [VSTax guide (FR)](https://neofidu.ch/guide/vstax): How to fill in the Valais tax return in VSTax, form by form, with official 2026 Valais deduction amounts and return codes (310, 1910, 2560, etc.)
- [VSTax guide (EN)](https://neofidu.ch/en/guide/vstax): English version for expats and holiday-home owners, quoting the French VSTax labels with translations
- Chapters: before you start, personal situation and children, salary and pensions, work expenses, pension savings (pillar 3a, 3a catch-up, buy-ins, lump sums), accounts/securities/crypto, wealth and debts, property (holiday homes, furnished lets), deductions, source tax/TOU/quasi-residents, checking and filing (https://neofidu.ch/guide/vstax/<chapter>)
- [FriTax guide (FR)](https://neofidu.ch/guide/fritax): How to fill in the Fribourg tax return in FriTax, section by section, with official 2026 Fribourg deduction amounts and return codes (1.110, 2.130, 4.110, 6.110, etc.)
- [FriTax guide (EN)](https://neofidu.ch/en/guide/fritax): English version for expats, quoting the French FriTax labels with translations
- Chapters: before you start (FriTax code, extensions), personal situation and children (boxes A/B/C), salary and pensions, work expenses (schedule 03), pension savings (pillar 3a, 3a catch-up, buy-ins, lump sums), accounts/securities/crypto (schedule 01, e-relevé), wealth and debts, property (schedule 04, upkeep, energy works), deductions, source tax/TOU/quasi-residents, checking and filing (72-hour correction window) (https://neofidu.ch/guide/fritax/<chapter>)
- [JuraTax guide (FR)](https://neofidu.ch/guide/juratax): How to fill in the Jura tax return with JuraTax Online or the JuraTax desktop program, section by section, with official 2026 Jura deduction amounts and return codes (100, 500, 525, 620, etc.) and forms (4, 5A, 7, 8, 9, 11)
- [JuraTax guide (EN)](https://neofidu.ch/en/guide/juratax): English version for expats, quoting the French JuraTax labels with translations
- Chapters: before you start (Online or desktop, Code-DI, SwissID, end-of-February deadline, CHF 31 extension), personal situation and children (married scale, unmarried and separated parents), salary and pensions, work expenses (form 7, actual costs or 20% flat rate), pension savings (pillar 3a, 3a catch-up, buy-ins, lump sums), accounts/securities/crypto (form 5A, eRelevé), wealth and debts (form 8), property (form 4, 10%/20% flat rate, energy works), deductions, source tax/TOU/quasi-residents/French cross-border workers, checking and filing (upload, summary page, supporting documents) (https://neofidu.ch/guide/juratax/<chapter>)
